verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developer docs with endpoint descriptions (POST /v1/employments), a sandbox test token, sample apps to clone, and an llms.txt file. None of it documents an interactive API reference or in-browser runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. Sample apps and the sandbox token are adjacent building blocks, not an interactive reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
